title: Missundaztood
headline: Perry offered 'Get the Party Started' to Madonna before Pink
caption:
When the sessions began in Perry's home studio, they wrote and recorded "Eventually" in about five minutes. Perry sat at the piano and asked Pink to put her feelings into a melody, and Pink felt petrified at first. Perry played chords, Pink picked up a mic and ad-libbed, and the vocal went down in one take.

Pink then moved into Perry's house for several months, and they came out with about 20 tracks in a month and a half. When she played four songs for producer L.A. Reid, he rejected most of the material but heard "Get the Party Started" as a lead single. Missundaztood came out on Arista 25 years ago today.

🎧 Key track: "Get the Party Started" by Pink (@pink)
